scope: Read-only integration lifecycle review; no source edits or browser launch
findings: Cache keys are bounded to modern (balanced/aurora) and archive (warm/default).
Same-variant reparent moves the grass mesh out of the old model before disposeMeshes visits it.
Cross-variant switching detaches the previous grass mesh before disposing the previous model.
Completed staging is empty after the model is committed, so later cancellation cannot dispose live cached grass.
Stale or cancelled loader requests dispose their own model and do not mutate the live cache.
updatePlants converts plant positions into the creation frame; reparent updates the current model reference while retaining local instance geometry.
Final renderer unmount explicitly disposes every cached controller, clears the cache, then disposes the scene and renderer.
runtimeEvidence: Not independently rerun here. The integration owner is capturing frozen-source four-theme checks, including one batch and per-variant UUID/buffer reuse.
